t3_bfs_dist: Directed frontier BFS with pre-wired channels (unscoped-lambda sender/receiver pairs per arc, pushed once into a vertex-keyed tuple tree); vertices run 2 local rounds per batch, balanced OR + one-batch lookahead. Keyed-trie Bellman-Ford variant (exp7 wsp engine) gave 1924.
t3_bipartite_comps: Label propagation on the doubled graph (v,p) -> 2v+p; component bipartite iff its min vertex keeps both own labels. Channel LP core. Keyed-trie LP variant 3759.
t3_cc_count: Channel LP core (min label), count vertices keeping their own id. exp7 keyed-trie version (strong-author baseline) was 2121.
t3_cc_label: Channel LP core (min label); output labels via tail-threaded flatten. Keyed-trie LP 3019; B=4 local rounds 1762 at seed0 but worse at seed1/dmax, kept B=2.
t3_cyclic_vertices: Transitive closure by repeated squaring of a bit matrix (one tuple tree: vertex levels then 16-bit word levels); each squaring ORs the rows selected by v's row (divide and conquer, all v in parallel); stops once a squaring changes nothing; v cyclic iff bit v of closure row v. Work ~ n^2*words per squaring. Channel variant (reachability rows over pre-wired channels): 2934 depth / 2.19M itrs, not kept (depth).
t3_dag_longest: Unchanged from runs/exp7 (strong-author Bend): multicast return wires make the DP a dataflow net.
t3_eccentricities: All-sources BFS with bitset balls exchanged over pre-wired channels: R'_v = R_v | OR of neighbours' rows; ecc(v) = rounds with R_v not full; 2 local rounds per batch, one-batch lookahead. Beats native on both metrics. Earlier variant selecting rows from the whole matrix per vertex: 3257 depth / 13M itrs (prev Bend 103M).
t3_greedy_coloring: Dataflow via return wires: for each edge (a<b) b gets a placeholder for colour(a); colour = lowest clear bit of the OR of 2^c (24-bit masks, corpus-size assumption). Depth is mostly the edge-list walk (~9 rounds/edge).
t3_lex_shortest_path: Packed cost W*128+H (assumes n <= 128, w <= 1000, corpus limits). Costs to t by channel label propagation (unscoped-lambda channels carrying edge costs, 2 local rounds per batch, one-batch lookahead); one keyed-trie emission computes nxt(x) = smallest y with D(y)+c(x,y) = D(x); path by keyed reads from s. Keyed-trie Bellman-Ford variant: 4721 depth / 540k itrs.
t3_reach_count: Same channel BFS engine as bfs_dist, count finite distances. Alternatives measured: keyed-trie BFS 4772 depth / 280k itrs; bit-matrix squaring 2008 depth / 3.0M itrs.
t3_two_colour: Doubled-graph label propagation (channel LP core); colour(v) = label(2v) & 1; non-bipartite iff some label(2v) = label(2v+1). Keyed-trie LP variant 4759.
t5_cluster_canon: Channel LP core with max labels. Keyed-trie LP variant 2353.
t5_cluster_count_ge: Channel LP (max), then sizes: 16-leaf groups thread one count tree through keyed increments at late label keys, group trees added leafwise; balanced count >= max(k,1). Dense all-onehot variant cost 3.2M itrs.
t5_cluster_singletons: n minus distinct endpoints: keyed set flags (collapse) in one walk, balanced count. At the list-walk floor (~9 rounds/cell).
t5_conflict_count: c list -> tuple tree (length walk and keyed-set walk in parallel; a fill-by-recursion build cost ~20 rounds/cell), mnl walk in parallel spawns two keyed reads per pair.
t5_conflict_pairs: As conflict_count; pairs inserted sorted into bucket a (structure depends only on keys, flags arrive later); tail-threaded filter-flatten.
t5_decide_normalise: Bucket sort: max-id walk and insertion walk in parallel; per-bucket sorted insert with max-merge; tail-threaded flatten.
t5_decide_stage_idem: Keyed trees over target*8+verb (ledger block flags, first-proposal index via keyed min), return wires deliver (block, first) to each proposal; output = chain of pick(keep_i, p_i, rest) cells resolving independently.
t5_decide_top_k: Bucket sort by 1000-score (10-level tree, score <= 1000 by contract), sorted insert by (u,v); subtree sizes annotated; parallel prefix take splits k at every node, tail-threaded.
t5_metric_rand: All pairs by divide and conquer (pairs(Z) = pairs(Z1) + pairs(Z2) + cross), works for arbitrary label values; O(n^2) work: 1.6M itrs vs prev 460k (depth 6.5x lower). No hashing/grouping of arbitrary 24-bit labels is cheap in Bend.
t5_prop_conflicts: Three parallel walks joined by return wires: attrs -> keyed (min,max) slots per node*4+key; c walk pushes node placeholders into cluster buckets (input keys, collapse); cluster folds slots with (min,max), counts min<max. Depth = attrs walk floor.
t5_rewrite_edges: Bitsets + return wires: T_u = OR of onehot(c[v]) over u's neighbours (c delivered by wires), R_x = OR of T_u over members of cluster x (pushed by input keys), tail-threaded listing of y > x. No data-dependent keyed routing.
